post.description:
Due diligence or M&A screening on one French company: SIREN, headcount band, revenue and executives in one call. Use search_companies first when you only have a name.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

siren.description: SIREN, 9 digits (spaces allowed, e.g. '542 051 180'); checked with the Luhn key. Pattern: ^\s*[0-9]{3}\s?[0-9]{3}\s?[0-9]{3}\s*$.

url.description: Alternative to siren: a pasted Annuaire des Entreprises link, https://annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr/entreprise/<name>-<siren> or /etablissement/<siret>.

200.description:
One French legal unit by SIREN (or a pasted annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr link): name, legal name, acronym, legal form with label, NAF activity with label, salaried headcount band decoded to a range, INSEE category, creation and cessation dates, status, head office (SIRET, address, postcode, commune, department, region, coordinates, activity, headcount), establishment counts, executives as published (natural persons with role, birth year/month and nationality when the source publishes them; legal entities such as auditors with their SIREN), latest published revenue and net income, VAT numbers, RNA id and public labels. not_found when the SIREN is unknown or not diffusible in open data.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `company` | object | One legal unit (unité légale). |
| `notice` | string | Source and licence attribution (Licence Ouverte / Etalab 2.0). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Retrieval time (ms since epoch). |
| `source_url` | string | The API request that answered. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Screening and prospect lists of French companies: e.g. software publishers (58.29C) or IT consultancies (62.02A) in Île-de-France with 50-249 employees and over EUR 10M revenue, manufacturers whose executive is 60+ (succession targets), ESS structures in a department, or finding a company's SIREN from its name. Chain `results[].siren` into get_company.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

commune_codes.description: INSEE commune codes (5 characters, e.g. 75056 Paris, 2A004 Ajaccio); matches units with an establishment there.

company_categories.description: INSEE company category: PME (SME), ETI (mid-cap), GE (large enterprise).

departments.description: Department codes (01-95, 2A, 2B, 971-976); matches units with an establishment there.

labels.description: Only units carrying all these public labels: ess (social and solidarity economy), sole_proprietorship (entreprise individuelle), association, local_authority (collectivité territoriale), mission_company (société à mission), public_administration, rge (RGE environmental certification), qualiopi (training quality), organic (Agence Bio), training_organization, siae (work-integration structure), finess (health/social facility), living_heritage (Entreprise du Patrimoine Vivant), entertainment_contractor (licence d'entrepreneur de spectacles), responsible_purchasing (RFAR label), alim_confiance (food-safety inspection published), uai (education establishment), egapro (gender pay-equality index published), collective_agreement (collective agreement IDCC on file).

legal_forms.description: INSEE legal categories (catégorie juridique, 4 digits): e.g. 5710 SAS, 5720 SASU, 5499 SARL, 5498 EURL, 5599/5699 SA, 5800 SE, 1000 sole proprietor, 9220 association.

naf_codes.description: Main activity of the legal unit, NAF rév. 2 / APE codes such as 62.01Z (6201Z accepted). Any of them matches.

naf_sections.description: NAF sections of the main activity: A agriculture, B mining, C manufacturing, D energy, E water/waste, F construction, G wholesale/retail trade, H transport, I accommodation/food, J information/communication, K finance/insurance, L real estate, M professional/scientific/technical (incl. head offices 70.10Z), N administrative support, O public administration, P education, Q health/social, R arts/recreation, S other services, T households, U extraterritorial.

net_income_max.description: Maximum net income of the latest published accounts, euros.

net_income_min.description: Minimum net income (résultat net) of the latest published accounts, euros (negative allowed).

page.description:
Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` from the previous answer. page * per_page may not exceed 10,000.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 1.

per_page.description:
Results per page, 1-25 (API cap).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 25; default 10.

person_birth_date_max.description: Latest birth date of an executive or elected official (YYYY-MM). For 'executive aged 60+' in October 2026, pass 1966-10. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(-[0-9]{2})?$.

person_birth_date_min.description: Earliest birth date of an executive or elected official (YYYY-MM; a day is accepted and ignored). For 'executive under 40' in 2026, pass 1986-11. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(-[0-9]{2})?$.

person_first_names.description: First name(s) of an executive or elected official.

person_last_name.description: Last name of an executive (dirigeant) or local elected official.

person_type.description:
Restrict the person filters to executives (dirigeants) or local elected officials (élus).

Provider reference: allowed values ["executive", "elected_official"].

postal_codes.description: Postal codes; matches legal units with at least one establishment there.

q.description: Free text over company names, addresses and executive or elected-official names, or a direct SIREN (9 digits) / SIRET (14 digits) lookup. At least 3 characters unless a filter is also given.

regions.description: INSEE region codes; matches units with an establishment there: 01 Guadeloupe, 02 Martinique, 03 Guyane, 04 La Réunion, 06 Mayotte, 11 Île-de-France, 24 Centre-Val de Loire, 27 Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, 28 Normandie, 32 Hauts-de-France, 44 Grand Est, 52 Pays de la Loire, 53 Bretagne, 75 Nouvelle-Aquitaine, 76 Occitanie, 84 Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, 93 Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, 94 Corse.

revenue_max.description: Maximum revenue of the latest published accounts, euros.

revenue_min.description: Minimum revenue (chiffre d'affaires) of the latest published accounts, euros. Units without published accounts never match.

sort_by_size.description: true: order by company size (number of establishments) instead of relevance.

status.description:
Administrative state of the legal unit in Sirene.

Provider reference: allowed values ["active", "ceased"].

200.description:
Search French legal units (unités légales) in Sirene + RNE by name, address, executive name or SIREN/SIRET, and/or filter by NAF activity code or section, salaried headcount band, INSEE category (PME/ETI/GE), legal form, postal code, commune, department, region, active/ceased status, public labels (ESS, sole proprietorship, association, RGE, Qualiopi, mission company...), latest revenue and net-income ranges, and executive or elected-official name and birth-date range. Each result is the full company record (legal form, NAF code and label, headcount band decoded to a range, category, creation date, status, head office with address and coordinates, executives, latest published revenue and net income, establishment counts, VAT numbers, labels) plus the establishments that matched the query. 10 per page by default (25 max), `next_page` continues; the API serves at most 10,000 results per query.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acronym` | string | Acronym (sigle). |
| `activity` | object | Main activity; null when not published. |
| `association_id` | string | RNA association identifier, for associations. |
| `category` | object | INSEE company size category (catégorie d'entreprise); null when not computed. |
| `ceased_on` | string | Cessation date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a ceased unit. |
| `created_on` | string | Creation date of the legal unit (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `diffusion_status` | string | Sirene diffusion status: O = public, P = partially public (some personal fields withheld at the person's request). |
| `establishments_count` | number | Number of establishments, open and closed. |
| `executives` | object[] | Executives (dirigeants) as published by the RNE / Sirene sources, in source order. Not enriched. |
| `finances` | object[] | Published annual accounts figures, newest year first; empty when none are published (accounts confidential, not filed, or not yet loaded). |
| `head_office` | object | Head office (siège) establishment; null for units without a Sirene establishment. |
| `headcount` | object | Salaried headcount band as published by INSEE Sirene; null when Sirene publishes none. |
| `labels` | string[] | Public labels and registers the unit belongs to (same names as the search `labels` filter). |
| `legal_form` | object | Legal form; null when not published. |
| `legal_name` | string | Registered legal name (raison sociale) for a legal person. |
| `matching_establishments` | object[] | Establishments that matched the query text or location filters (up to 10); empty for a plain SIREN or filter-only match. |
| `name` | string | Display name composed by the API (legal name, trade name and acronym in parentheses; first and last name for a sole proprietor). |
| `open_establishments_count` | number | Number of open establishments. |
| `siren` | string | SIREN, the 9-digit legal-unit identifier. |
| `status` | string | Sirene administrative state of the legal unit; null for RNE-only units without a Sirene record. |
| `updated_at` | string | Last update of the unit in the API index (ISO 8601). |
| `vat_numbers` | string[] | Active French intra-community VAT numbers (DGFiP). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
